title: Hide and Seek
text:
Hide and seek is a traditional game. Children play it in parks and gardens. One child closes his eyes and counts to ten. The other children hide.

After the counting, the child opens his eyes and looks for them. The first child who is found becomes the next seeker. Everyone laughs and has fun.

questions.text: How high does the seeker count?

options: The first child who is found
The last child who is found

questions.text: Why do the children probably play hide and seek?
What is the children's main feeling at the end of the game?

vocabulary.definition: passed down from one generation to the next
areas of land where flowers, plants or trees grow
a person who looks for someone or something
to put yourself where other people cannot see you

paragraph_translations: Esconde-esconde é um jogo tradicional. As crianças brincam nos parques e nos jardins. Uma criança fecha os olhos e conta até dez. As outras crianças se escondem.
Depois da contagem, a criança abre os olhos e procura por elas. A primeira criança encontrada se torna a próxima a procurar. Todos riem e se divertem.
